Hey:
Sorry I've taken a few days to respond.  Just the more I think about it, the worse of an idea it seems for both of us to collaborate on the Clinique des Cèdres project.  There is nothing good that can come of it either professionally or personally.  I still regard you as a good friend.  Nothing has changed that nor do I think we need to act weird around each other going forward.  Something I think we both wanted to try and we did.  Maybe best left there though.
